description: Search researcher/author records by display name. Returns Semantic Scholar author ID, name, institutional affiliations, total paper count, total citation count, and h-index. Useful for identifying a researcher before filtering semanticscholar.papers_search results by author, or for author-level impact metrics. Data: api.semanticscholar.org, no auth required.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-25, default 10)

query.description: Search query for researcher/author name (e.g. "geoffrey hinton")

name: semanticscholar.authors.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Semantic Scholar Authors Search
